कुप् {vI.v} {c4c} P. (कुप्यति, चुकोप, अकुपत्,
कोपितुं, कुपित)
1 To be angry,
(generally with the dat. of the
person who is the object of anger,
but sometimes with the acc. or
gen. also); कुप्यतिं हितवादिने

.
--2 To be excited, to gather
strength, be virulent; as in दोषाः
प्रकुप्यंति Suśr. --Caus. (कोपयति-ते)
1
To provoke, irritate; to excite,
agitate.
--2 To stir up. {vII.v} {c10c}

कूप् {c10c} U. (कूपयति-ते, कूपित)
1 To
be weak.
--2 To weaken.

कुपः Ved. The beam or lever of a
pair of scales.

; so
नितरां नीचोस्मीति त्वं खेदं कूप मा कदापि
कृथाः । अत्यंतसरसहृदयो यतः परेषां
गुणग्रहीतासि

; प्रोद्दीप्ते भवने तु
कूपखननं प्रत्यद्यमः कीदृशः

.
--2
A hole, cave, hollow, cavity; as in
जघनकूप; Śi. 7. 74.
--3 A leather
oil-vessel.
--4 A post to which a ship
is moored.
--5 A tree or rock in the
midst of a river.
--6 A mast;
क्षोणीनौकूपदंडः

.
--पी
1 A small
well.
--2 A flask, bottle.
--3 The
navel.
--Comp.
--अंकः, --अंगः
horripilation.
--कच्छपः, --मंडूकः, --मंडूकी^1 (lit.)
a tortoise or frog in a well; (fig.)
an inexperienced person, one who
has had no experience of the world
at large, a man of limited ideas
who knows only his own
neighbourhood; oft. used as a term of
reproach.
--यंत्रं a water-wheel, a
contrivance for raising water from
a well. ˚यंत्रघटी-घटिका a bucket or
pot attached to the water-wheel
to draw up water. ˚यंत्रघटिकान्याय
see under न्याय.
[1] Correction submitted by User SergeA on 20211221. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/724. note: for clarity.

कुपय a. Ved. To be guarded or
protected.

कुपिनी^1 A kind of net for
catching small fish.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

कुपूय a. Despised, low, mean,
contemptible.

कुविं(पिं)दः
1 A weaver;
कुविंदस्त्वं तावत्पटयसि गुणग्राममभितः
K.

1 A well (temporary).
--2 A hole, cave, cavity.
--3 The
hollow below the loins.
--4 A stake
to which a boat is moored.
--5 The
mast of a ship.
--6 A funeral pile.
--7 A hole under a funeral pile.
--8
A leather oil-vessel.
--9 A rock or
tree in the midst of a river.
--10
A boat.
--पिका A stone or rock in
the midst of a stream.
कूप्य a. Being in a well or hole.
